title: Guider detach leaks its Multi Kernel GP reset property
description:
Category functional; severity low; confidence high. Owner coordinator; open, nonblocking audit follow-up. Location: indigo_drivers/agent_guider/indigo_agent_guider.c:2782-2786,:3267-3305. AGENT_GUIDER_RESET_MKGP_PROPERTY is allocated and exposed, but agent_device_detach releases RESET_PPEC and all the other custom property allocations while omitting RESET_MKGP. The macro points to the independent agent_reset_mkgp_property field, not an alias of RESET_PPEC. Repeated agent instances/load/unload leak one property per instance. Whole-agent source allocation/release pairing found this sole custom uppercase-property mismatch. Release this property alongside RESET_PPEC after stopping callbacks. Verify repeated attach/detach allocation accounting. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (FM-6). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
